provisions.citation: Annex III, introductory paragraph and point (b)
provisions.summary: Delegated acts under Art. 4 specify, from a list of twelve elements (a) to (l), which data are or can be included in the digital product passport; point (b) is the unique product identifier at the level set in the applicable delegated act.
provisions.applies_to: Commission delegated acts per product group; DPP data content
provisions.applicable_from: Condition: each delegated act adopted under Art. 4
provisions.conditions: Annex III is a menu from which each delegated act selects; it does not itself set a mandatory data set. Batteries are governed by Regulation (EU) 2023/1542.

provisions.summary: One selectable DPP data element is the Global Trade Identification Number as provided for in ISO/IEC 15459-6 or equivalent, for products or their parts. The standard is named without a year here, while the second paragraph of the Annex names the 2014 edition.
provisions.applies_to: Products or their parts; DPP data content where a delegated act selects this element
provisions.applicable_from: Condition: each delegated act adopted under Art. 4
provisions.conditions: 'Or equivalent' appears in this point. Year is absent in point (c) but present in the second paragraph.

provisions.summary: The data carrier, the unique product identifier (point (b)), the unique operator identifiers (points (g), (h), (k)) and the unique facility identifiers (point (i)) must, where relevant for the products concerned, comply with ISO/IEC 15459-1:2014, -2:2015, -3:2014, -4:2014, -5:2014 and -6:2014 (numbers and years as written).
provisions.applies_to: Data carriers and identifiers of ESPR digital product passports
provisions.applicable_from: Condition: a DPP required by an Art. 4 delegated act
provisions.conditions: 'Where relevant for the products concerned'. No 'or equivalent' wording in this paragraph as read; interaction with Arts 10 and 12 (equivalents, harmonised standards) not examined. The same six dated editions as Art. 77(3) of Regulation 2023/1542.
